state.case_summary:
A previously healthy 60-year-old man comes to his physician because of progressively worsening shortness of breath for the past 2 months. He does not experience shortness of breath at rest. He also occasionally has a dry cough. He has not had fever, chills, or night sweats. He has smoked a pack of cigarettes daily for the past 40 years. He drinks a beer daily and occasionally more on weekends. He does not use illicit drugs. He is 183 cm (6 ft 0 in) tall and weighs 66 kg (145 lbs); BMI is 19.7 kg/m2. His temperature is 37 °C (98.6 °F), pulse is 94/min, respirations are 21/min, and blood pressure is 136/88 mm Hg. Lung auscultation reveals a prolonged expiratory phase and end-expiratory wheezing. Spirometry shows an FEV1:FVC ratio of 62%, an FEV1 of 60% of predicted, and a total lung capacity of 125% of predicted. The diffusion capacity of the lung (DLCO) is decreased. What is the most likely diagnosis?

B. asthma
C. bronchiectasis

root.label: Subacute Progressive Dyspnea Syndrome with Chronic Cough and Smoking History
supporting_facts: progressively worsening shortness of breath for the past 2 months
abnormal lung auscultation with prolonged expiratory phase and end-expiratory wheezing
abnormal spirometry with FEV1:FVC ratio of 62% and decreased DLCO
excluded_candidates: Pneumonia: reason ranked lower due to lack of fever, chills, or night sweats
Pulmonary Embolism: reason ranked lower due to lack of acute onset and absence of risk factors for thromboembolism
Interstitial Lung Disease: reason ranked lower due to lack of systemic symptoms and normal total lung capacity

B1.label: Lower Respiratory Infection
askable_discriminators: Have you recently been exposed to anyone with a respiratory infection?

B2.label: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) Spectrum
askable_discriminators: Have you noticed a worsening of symptoms over time?

B3.label: Pulmonary Restrictive Pattern Disorders
askable_discriminators: Have you experienced any systemic symptoms such as fever or weight loss?

B4.label: Inflammatory Airway Diseases
askable_discriminators: Have you experienced any allergic reactions or asthma-like symptoms?

B5.label: Other
askable_discriminators: Have you experienced any other symptoms or have a family history of diseases?
